description: The Meridian Dispatch account this connection is signed in to: the name (and email, unless the traveller hid it from Apple), when it was made, whether the app on a phone is signed in to it, its plan titles, and whether travel preferences are saved. Use it to confirm the account before editing, since a traveller can hold two Apple accounts. Needs sign-in.
name: get_my_account
title: Which account am I signed in as
